name: sandbox-desktop
description: Secure macOS shell for the local Sandbox dashboard

scripts.package:mac:dir: npm run test && SANDBOX_MAC_PACKAGE_MODE=local CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal --dir && npm run smoke:mac
scripts.package:mac: npm run clean && npm run icon && npm run test && SANDBOX_MAC_PACKAGE_MODE=local CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal && node scripts/artifact-manifest.mjs && npm run smoke:mac
scripts.package:mac:signed: npm run clean && npm run icon && npm run test && SANDBOX_MAC_PACKAGE_MODE=signed electron-builder --mac --universal --config.forceCodeSigning=true && node scripts/artifact-manifest.mjs
scripts.run:mac: npm run package:mac:dir && npm run open:mac
